title: Regulatory Approval for Novavax Vaccine and Vaccination for Short-term Visit Pass Holders Staying with Long-term Residents in Singapore
what_it_is: Regulatory Approval for Novavax Vaccine and Vaccination for Short-term Visit Pass Holders Staying with Long-term Residents in Singapore

sections.label: Vaccination progress and seniors
sections.summary: As of 31 July 2021, 61% of the population completed full vaccination and 79% of those aged 70 and above received at least one dose.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: As of 31 July 2021, 61% of our population have completed the full vaccination regimen.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are also making steady progress with our seniors: 79% of those aged 70 and above have been vaccinated with at least one dose.

sections.label: Seniors without vaccination appointments
sections.summary: More than 96,000, or 21%, of seniors aged 70 and above have not booked a vaccination appointment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: More than 96,000 or 21% of seniors aged 70 and above have not booked a vaccination appointment.

sections.label: HSA review of data
sections.summary: HSA is conducting a careful and thorough review of the data and aims to complete its evaluation before the end of August.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: HSA is conducting a careful and thorough review of the data and aims to complete its evaluation before the end of August.

sections.label: Studying standards for consideration
sections.summary: It must be studied to meet standards of quality, safety and efficacy, and it is premature to guarantee it will be considered like other processes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We need to study it and make sure that it meets the standards of quality, safety and efficacy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And, in principle, if it does meet those same standards, I see no reason why it should not be considered in the same way as the other processes that I have just described.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But I think it is premature at this point to guarantee that it will be.

sections.label: Shorter-stay people vaccination process
sections.summary: They are studying how, when and the process through which people here for a shorter period can potentially get the vaccine, with details announced later.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: As I have explained, we are studying how, when and the process through which people who are here for a shorter period of time can potentially get the vaccine and details will be announced later.

sections.label: Similar principles for risk
sections.summary: In general, similar principles will be applied around risks and whether the person is at risk in terms of COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In general, we will apply similar principles which are around risks and whether the person is at risk in terms of COVID-19.
